0.original: <hex:024804F201FC03><hex:024904F201FD03> Quest Sync<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103><hex:02100103>A flyer for attracting prospective employees catches your eye.

27.original: Express your /doubt to the Mord taskmaster.

48.original: Onest paye foR onest woRk! No expeerRians ness ess haiRy!

49.original: It appears to be a job advertisement. Speak with the Mord taskmaster for details.

50.original: It appears to be a job advertisement, most likely written by the Mord taskmaster.

51.original: Mmm... You'll do. Here for work, are we?

52.original: Good, good! Honest pay for honest work, that's my motto!

53.original: Your timing could not be better. I have a job for you.

54.original: Take this package to my client, who is outside the village, to the south. Mord fellow, you will know him when you see him. Probably.

55.original: Now, listen carefully. You must not peek inside, no matter what! Is that clear? Good. Now, off you go!

56.original: You understood my instructions, yes? Then why are you still here?

57.original: Ah, there is the parcel. Get <hex:02080DE905FF04686572FF0468696D03>!

58.original: You are back!? But that was not how─ Ahem! The client will ah...re-unpurse you, I mean, reimburse you. Now, be off!

59.original: You were not supposed to fight back! Not fair, not fair!

60.original: Our job was to steal the package, not to hurt anyone, I swear!

61.original: Ask the taskmaster! Yes! He will tell you everything.

63.original: Is there a problem? Still looking for the client, are we?

64.original: He seems to be hiding something. Use the <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>doubt<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> emote to wring the truth from him.

66.original: The truth is, there is no client. And the package is full of nothing but rocks. Not expensive ones, either. Just rocks!

67.original: I hire people to deliver the parcel and another group of thugs to steal it. When they return to me empty-handed, I demand compensation for the loss of my wares. No blood spilled, just coin changing hands, that is all!

68.original: Please, boss, no more. This is too complicated, too dangerous!

69.original: You are right. There must be easier ways to make money. We need something that requires less effort, less risk! Hmm...

70.original: Ahem! Kind traveler, will you accept this as an apology? And maybe no one needs to know about this, yes?
